purpose: Blueprint 2026-09-08 §34: every state-changing API route classified by the credential it accepts, so the CSRF posture of the surface is a checked-in fact rather than a re-derived opinion. lib/route-classification.test.ts fails when a route gains a state-changing method without an entry here, when an entry names a file that no longer exists, or when a route's methods drift from what is recorded.

legend.A-bearer: Privilege comes only from an Authorization: Bearer header. A cross-site request cannot attach one ambiently, so classic browser CSRF does not reach it. Requires: no wildcard credentialed CORS origin.
legend.B-cookie: Privilege comes from an ambient cookie or session. Requires SameSite policy plus Origin/Referer validation or an anti-CSRF token. NO ROUTE IN THIS REPOSITORY IS TYPE B; adding one without an origin guard fails the test.
legend.C-webhook: Privilege comes from a signature over the raw request body. Requires raw-body verification, a replay window, and event dedupe.
legend.D-oauth-callback: Provider redirect. Requires state, PKCE, and a fixed redirect policy.
legend.P-public: Accepts no credential and grants no tenant privilege. Nothing exists for a forged request to ride, so origin checks here are anti-abuse, not CSRF defence.

corsPosture: No route sets any Access-Control-Allow-* header, and next.config.mjs adds none. There is therefore no credentialed cross-origin access and no wildcard origin anywhere on the API surface. lib/route-classification.test.ts asserts this.
cookies: The only Set-Cookie on the API surface is the self-service trial device cookie (lib/self-service-trial.ts:69, HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax). It is an abuse signal consumed by bootstrap_foundation_self_service_trial, never an authorization credential: app/api/access/bootstrap/route.ts rejects the request with AUTH_REQUIRED before reading it unless a Bearer JWT is present.

app/api/access/bootstrap/route.ts.note: Sets the trial device cookie, but requires the Bearer JWT first.

app/api/contact/route.ts.note: Same-origin allowlist, application/json only, 16KB cap, honeypot, per-process IP+domain rate limit. Durable limit blocked on a migration; see the ponytail note in the route.

app/api/internal/billing/settle/route.ts.note: lib/compute-settlement-auth.ts: digest over the raw body, 300s timestamp window, request id.

app/api/internal/jobs/run/route.ts.note: FOUNDATION_WORKER_SECRET / CRON_SECRET, constant-time compare, closed when unset. Cross-tenant by design; never reachable with a customer credential.

app/api/operations/p0/admission/route.ts.note: planLargeDocumentAdmission is a pure policy calculator: no read, no write, no tenant data. 4KB body cap. Unauthenticated compute; edge rate limit is backlog.

app/api/paddle/webhook/route.ts.note: lib/paddle-webhook.ts: HMAC over `ts:rawBody`, 300s window; dedupe by p_event_id in lib/billing-store.ts.

app/api/v1/oauth-connectors/authorize/ro.note: Mints the state + PKCE verifier consumed by the callback.

app/api/v1/oauth-connectors/callback/[pr.note: State is single-use and consumed by hash (consumeOAuthAuthorization), PKCE verifier is read from the secret broker, and the redirect URI must equal the runtime-configured one. GET, so it is not a state-changing method by shape, but it is state-changing in effect and is classified deliberately.
